mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right stucco contractor for my home remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right stucco contractor is crucial for a successful project. Look for contractors who are licensed, insured, and have a proven track record specifically with stucco installation or repair. Request references from previous clients and review their portfolios to assess the quality of their work. It's also important to get multiple detailed bids to compare not just price, but also the scope of work, materials used, and warranty information. A reliable contractor will also communicate clearly, answer your questions, and provide a comprehensive project plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a stucco contractor by verifying their license and insurance, checking references and portfolios, and comparing multiple detailed bids for scope and warranty.
